Direction: **Choose the word which is most nearly the same in meaning as the given word.**

Ancillary
solution:
The correct answer is '**Subsidiary**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ancillary means 'providing necessary support to the main work or activities of an organization, in addition to something else but not as important ( मुख्‍य गतिविधियों में सहायक, गौण, आनुषंगिक)'.

 
 
• Ex: Usually they will be merely **ancillary **to the strictly religious activities.
